decisive_spans.text: color Doppler imaging revealed a vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion

response.rationale: The presence of a vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion is a specific finding that strongly supports Glomus tumor (D10). While Leiomyosarcoma (D6) also mentions a vascular signal, it does not specify the characteristic 'extending from the periphery into the center' pattern.
